item.title: Piers Morgan panel derails as far-left guest erupts over Iran war, slams Israel
item.summary: Cenk Uygur clashed with Piers Morgan and panelists during a heated debate over President Donald Trump, Israel and U.S. involvement in Iran on "Piers Morgan Uncensored."

item.title: DAVID MARCUS: The MAGA 'civil war' over Iran is a myth
item.summary: Polls show 83% of Republicans back Trump's Iran strikes, undermining media claims of a MAGA split over the conflict, according to L&V and Politico surveys.

item.title: Most Americans expect Trump to send boots on the ground in Iran — but majority oppose it: Poll
item.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll finds 55% of Americans oppose sending U.S. ground troops into the conflict with Iran, as nearly two-thirds fear Trump will do so.

item.title: Slain Loyola Chicago student's family fumes over 'murder,' manhunt for masked gunman in attack near campus
item.summary: The family of Loyola University Chicago student Sheridan Gorman demands answers after she was shot and killed near campus in a seemingly random attack.

item.title: Actor and martial artist Chuck Norris dead at 86
item.summary: Chuck Norris, iconic actor and martial artist, has died, his family announced in a statement, saying he passed surrounded by loved ones and at peace.

item.title: Thune reveals reason Democrats are 'scared' to reopen DHS
item.summary: The DHS shutdown hit 35 days as Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D., accused Democrats of being "scared" of their far-left base.

item.title: Trump-backed Senate hopeful gains momentum with top GOP endorsements before Mullin DHS shift
item.summary: Rep. Kevin Hern was endorsed for U.S. Senate by Senate Majority Leader John Thune and National Republican Senatorial Committee chair Sen. Tim Scott.

item.title: Spring break hot spot declares state of emergency, curfew after rowdy takeovers spark mass arrests
item.summary: Daytona Beach declared a state of emergency and a 7-day overnight curfew for minors after an unsanctioned spring break event led to 130+ arrests.

item.title: CBS News announces layoffs, bosses acknowledge 'difficult day' as dozens of staffers expected to be impacted
item.summary: CBS News announced it is implementing a new round of layoffs that will impact dozens of staffers across the newsroom, according to a memo obtained by Fox News Digital.

item.title: Jimmy Gracey's death deemed accidental after vanishing on spring break in Barcelona, autopsy performed
item.summary: Spanish police say Jimmy Gracey, a 20-year-old University of Alabama student, died accidentally in Barcelona after vanishing near Shoko nightclub.
